description: Use when an agent needs named fields from a page or PDF. Returns JSON for a schema of up to 20 fields (string, number, boolean, date, string[]), with null for anything the document does not state, never an invented value. Costs 0.025 USDC per call (x402, USDC on Solana, Base, Polygon, Arbitrum or Arc).

schema.description: JSON object of field name to type, e.g. {"title":"string","price":"number","released":"date"}; up to 20 fields and 2 KB

url.description: the page or PDF: an absolute http or https URL

name: get_extract

data.description: the get_extract payload; a real captured example is free at https://x402.ochinimus.app/api/sample/get_extract

tool.description: the tool that produced this payload

title: Structured extraction
